L9: # Title:New inhomogeneous Bismut Hermitian-Einstein threefolds with large symmetry group
L10: 
L11: Authors:【5†Fabio Podestà】, 【6†Alberto Raffero】
L12: 
L13: View a PDF of the paper titled New inhomogeneous Bismut Hermitian-Einstein threefolds with large symmetry group, by Fabio Podest\`a and 1 other authors

L15: 【7†View PDF】 【8†HTML (experimental)】
L16: > Abstract:We study compact non-Kähler Bismut Hermitian-Einstein threefolds whose connected full group of holomorphic isometries acts with cohomogeneity one. We prove that the Lie algebra of this group is isomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^3\oplus\mathfrak{su}(2)$ or $\mathbb{R}^2\oplus\mathfrak{su}(2)$, unless the Bismut connection is flat.
L17: We then focus on the first case, where we determine the possible singular isotropy algebras and reduce the Bismut Hermitian-Einstein condition to a system of ordinary differential equations.
L18: We obtain explicit solutions satisfying suitable smoothness conditions, that yield families of compact and complete non-compact non-Kähler Bismut Hermitian-Einstein threefolds with non-constant scalar curvature and non-zero Bismut curvature, including examples on $S^3\times S^3$ and $S^3\times S^1\times\mathbb{R}^2$, respectively. We also investigate the topology of the compact examples and determine the asymptotic scalar curvature of the non-compact ones.
L19: Moreover, we prove the existence of a smooth deformation of a Bismut-flat Samelson structure on $S^3\times S^3$ through non-Kähler Bismut Hermitian-Einstein structures that are not Bismut-flat. The regularity of the constructed compact examples is also investigated.
